title: Add agency API functions to React TypeScript client
description:
Modify react_ui/src/api/client.ts to add TypeScript fetch functions for all agency API endpoints: get/update initiative settings, poll/dismiss/read notifications, trigger proactive check-ins, and fetch user schedule.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client — understand base URL configuration, fetch wrapper patterns, TypeScript type conventions, and error handling)
- chatbot/api/agency.py (created by task a.7 — understand the endpoint paths, query parameters, request bodies, and response shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Implementation:

1. Open react_ui/src/api/client.ts and inspect: base URL config (BASE_URL), fetch wrapper patterns, TypeScript type conventions (interface vs type, PascalCase), error handling.

2. Add TypeScript types: InitiativeSettings (user_id string, level union type of five level strings, quiet_hours_start string|null, quiet_hours_end string|null), InitiativeUpdatePayload (level string, quiet_hours_start string|null, quiet_hours_end string|null), NotificationItem (notification_id, user_id, notif_type, title, body, created_at, read, dismissed, metadata), NotificationListResponse (notifications NotificationItem[], pending_count number), CheckInTriggerPayload (checkin_type string, user_id string, context object|null), CheckInResponse (checkin_id, message, checkin_type, priority), ScheduleResponse (events object[], next_event object|null).

3. Add async fetch functions: fetchInitiative(userId), updateInitiative(userId, payload), fetchNotifications(userId, since?), markNotificationRead(notificationId), dismissNotification(notificationId), triggerCheckIn(payload), fetchSchedule(userId). All follow existing client.ts patterns for fetch, error handling, and return types.

4. Do NOT modify existing exports, change the fetch wrapper, or add new HTTP libraries.
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports all seven agency API functions
react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports InitiativeSettings, InitiativeUpdatePayload, NotificationItem, NotificationListResponse, CheckInTriggerPayload, CheckInResponse, and ScheduleResponse types
All new functions use the existing fetch wrapper or URL pattern from client.ts
fetchNotifications supports optional since query parameter
Existing API functions and types in client.ts are unchanged
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: remove or rename existing exported functions or types from client.ts
introduce a new HTTP client library (axios, react-query, etc.)
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: add TypeScript interfaces/types matching the API Pydantic models
add async fetch wrapper functions following existing client.ts patterns
use the existing base URL and error handling conventions
forbidden: introduce axios, react-query, swr, or any new HTTP/data-fetching library
change the fetch wrapper pattern or base URL configuration
add polling intervals or WebSocket logic
